papers.title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
papers.summary: NCP-ArchPreview is a large latent-space language model that jointly trains next-token and next-concept prediction to improve pretraining efficiency and downstream performance.

papers.title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence
papers.summary: SenseNova-U1.5 is an 8B native unified multimodal model that performs visual understanding, reasoning, and generation without encoders or VAEs, achieving high fidelity and instruction following through patch reconstruction, curated data, expert optimization, and on-policy distillation.

papers.title: SpatialBlock: Enhancing Spatial Intelligence in LVLMs via Synthetic Block-Stacking Problem
papers.summary: Large vision-language models trained on synthetic block-manipulation tasks improve 3D spatial reasoning and generalize to real-world visual tasks.

papers.title: EvoSafeHarness: Evolving Model- and Domain-Specific Harnesses for Securing Agents
papers.summary: EvoSafeHarness optimizes deployable safety harnesses by jointly searching natural-language policies and executable logic tailored to a frozen model and target domain, improving safety-utility trade-offs across agent benchmarks.

papers.title: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing
papers.summary: Mi-Ripple reduces digital ripple artifacts in edited images by separating lattice artifacts from texture and applying targeted spectral filtering and reference cleaning.
